## About
Advanced Collision Engineering is a body shop in Laguna Hills that handles collision repair, bodywork and paint. When your car comes in after an accident, we look it over, explain what it needs and give you a clear estimate before we start.
Our customers have given us a 4.8 rating from 31 Google reviews. One reviewer said their car came back looking shinier than the day they drove it off the dealership, and another called us the go-to body shop in Orange County.
We're open weekdays. Give us a call or stop by and we'll take a look.

## Services
- Collision repair: Repairs after an accident, done with close attention to detail so the damage is hard to spot afterward.
- Paint work for scrapes: Paint work for scrapes and body damage. One reviewer said you'd never guess their car had been damaged.
- Supercar service and repair: One reviewer pointed to our staff's experience servicing and repairing supercars.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Will you talk with my insurance company?
A: Yes, we can keep in touch with your insurance company. One reviewer said we communicated with both them and their insurer throughout the repair.

Q: Will I know what my car needs before you start?
A: Yes. We'll walk you through the repairs your car needs and give you a clear estimate.
